Topology.title: Resilient Branch Office Network
Topology.Description: Design for a branch office with redundant routers, MPLS WAN connectivity, and survivable voice capabilities.
Topology.Summary: The branch office will have redundant routers connected via MPLS to the main data center. It will also have direct connections to the PSTN and a SIP provider for survivable voice functionality.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new1) that is connected to the primary and secondary routers, MFA/Identity Server, and Central AAA Server, indicating the presence of an asset inventory system.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n22) that is connected to the secondary router, indicating the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., 'Data Center', 'Management Zone', 'Security Zone', 'Non-Production Zone') that are connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating segmentation based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n9) that is connected to both the primary and secondary routers, indicating the presence of a firewall on the network.
